name: trickshot
description: Trick Shot — precision chain-hoop arcade on Celo

scripts.build: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/web && npm run build -w @trickshot/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @trickshot/shared && npm run build -w @trickshot/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/shared && npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/web && npm run typecheck -w @trickshot/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @trickshot/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @trickshot/api --if-present
